derived_subregion_bindings.rule: Derived subregions are non-sovereign local overlays. They reference R2 cities and POIs but never duplicate or replace them.

catalog_overlays.resource_and_profession: May attach only to existing political units, biomes, cities, POIs or approved local overlays.
catalog_overlays.npc_role: May attach only as a generic scene role; named R2 appearance requires an authorial gate.
catalog_overlays.encounter: May attach as contextual behavior; exact positions and spawn counts are runtime-only.
catalog_overlays.balance: May select technical tuning tier, never canonical difficulty or power level.
